subject: Re: RiverEcho SIG — data segmentation, KMS, and retention evidence
messages:
From: Katie Morris <katie.morris@riverecho.com>
To: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legal@riverecho.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: SIG Questionnaire — data segmentation, KMS, retention evidence needed

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the SIG. We finished our first pass and have three tight asks before we can move to final review:

1) Data segmentation: We need explicit evidence showing logical separation of customer data across multi-tenant clusters (configs, tenant-id routing rules, and a short narrative of how segmentation is enforced at the serving/runtime layer).

2) KMS key usage: A diagram showing where keys are used (at-rest encryption, envelope encryption, caching/kv-store encryption), plus screenshots or export of key policies that indicate separation of customer keys from platform keys.

3) Retention & E2E logs: Example retention configuration for prompt and KV caches, and a sample (redacted) audit log demonstrating deletion/retention cycle for a tenant.

Can you provide these items and an ETA? Our security team needs specific artifacts (not just narrative) to close their review.

Appreciate it — let's aim for next-week delivery if possible.

Katie
Katie Morris
Head of Security, RiverEcho
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:41:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: SIG Questionnaire — triage + owners (RiverEcho RE-5274)

Team — routing RiverEcho's asks (see below). TL;DR: they want control-level artifacts for data segmentation, KMS usage, and retention/audit samples.

Proposed owners:
- Kimberly: control mapping + tenant-seg configs + sample screenshots (you own the proofpack).
- Jonas: KMS diagram + key policy export (we'll supply a sanitized policy).
- Jasmine: retention config and a redacted audit log sample for deletion lifecycle.

Constraints: avoid shipping raw keys or real PII. All artifacts must be redacted per our evidence-handling runbook.

Can you confirm owners and an ETA by EOD? I'll coordinate packaging and the Drive share.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG Questionnaire — control mapping + artifacts (RiverEcho)

On Fri, Nov 20, 2026 at 9:41 AM Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Team — routing RiverEcho's asks (see below). TL;DR: they want control-level artifacts for data segmentation, KMS usage, and retention/audit samples.

All right — I pulled the control map and built an evidence pack for RiverEcho. Attached items I'm adding to the shared Drive (see metadata below):

- RE-5274_control-mapping.xlsx (control crosswalk: SIG control ID -> our control -> artifact name + owner)
- kms-key-flow-diagram.pdf (sanitized architecture diagram showing envelope encryption, hardware-backed KMS boundaries, and where tenant-specific keys are invoked)
- retention-policy-snippets.txt (redacted config snippets for prompt/kv retention and TTL policies)
- soc2-summary-page.pdf (high-level SOC 2 status page; full report available under NDA
)

Notes on evidence: the retention sample is a sanitized log extracted via our evidence tooling (timestamps and tenant IDs replaced with placeholders). For KMS policies we exported role bindings with sensitive principals redacted.

ETA: I can upload the Drive folder and send RiverEcho the access link tomorrow (Tue EOD PST). If they need a signed attestation or a legal view, we should loop Legal.

- Kim
Kimberly Park
Manager, Assurance & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: Katie Morris <katie.morris@riverecho.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legal@riverecho.com, samuel.ortega@riverecho.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG Questionnaire — additional ask on audit logs and ISO certificate

Thanks Kim — that list looks good. Two follow-ups before we accept the Drive bundle: 

1) Can you include a short README (1 page) that explains how to navigate the artifacts and which control(s) each file substantiates? Our auditors prefer that mapping.

2) We also need a sample of the audit log that shows an actual deletion event lifecycle (create -> mark for deletion -> tombstone -> purge) for a tenant (redacted). If you cannot provide a real lifecycle log, a sequence diagram plus a time-stamped, redacted extract is fine.

3) Last: do you have an ISO 27001 certificate reference (scope, cert body) we can include? Our procurement team will ask for it during final sign-off.

If you can get the README + one lifecycle extract up by Friday (Nov 27), we'll plan to close the SIG review next week.

Katie
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Katie Morris <katie.morris@riverecho.com>, legal@riverecho.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RiverEcho SIG — artifacts uploaded (RE-5274)

Katie — thanks for the clear asks. We uploaded the artifact bundle to a scoped Drive share and included a one-page README that maps files to the SIG controls. Deliverables in the share:

- RE-5274_control-mapping.xlsx (control crosswalk)
- kms-key-flow-diagram.pdf (sanitized)
- retention-policy-snippets.txt (config excerpts)
- soc2-summary-page.pdf (summary)
- retention-lifecycle-sample.json (redacted event sequence showing create -> mark -> tombstone -> purge)
- readme_RE-5274.pdf (artifact map and brief navigation guidance)

Links: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/RE-5274/evidence (access granted to riverecho@riverecho.com via view-only link).

ISO certification: Redwood maintains ISO 27001:2013 scope for our hosted platform (certified by AcmeCert). We attached the formal reference in the Drive (soc2-summary-page.pdf contains the cert body and scope statement; full cert available on request with an NDA).

Notes: All artifacts are redacted to remove tenant identifiers and any PII. If RiverEcho legal needs a signed attestation or to request the unredacted log under an NDA, please let us know and we'll route through Security and Legal.

Next step: Kim will stand up a short walkthrough call if you'd like — propose Tue 12/1 at 10am PT.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
